name: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
source:
It’s the year 20XX and 11 world-renowned college-age experts have agreed to take a rocket ride into space where they will take part in a first-of-its-kind intensive summer program run by the world’s top governing authority. 


Their goal? Prove that they are the best of the best and worthy of the exclusive title: 


World☆Class.


What begins as a relaxing stay at a lavish baroque space resort-turned-college-campus takes a deadly turn when it’s revealed that only 5 individuals will be leaving the program with their title…


...and their lives.
